style.prompt: Turn this photo into a classic meme. Keep the photo of the surprised tabby cat on the grey sofa exactly as it is. Add big bold white Impact-style capital letters with a thick black outline. At the very top edge of the image, the text: "WHEN YOU THINK IT'S FRIDAY". At the very bottom edge of the image, the text: "BUT IT'S ONLY TUESDAY". Spell the words exactly. The text must not cover the cat's eyes or face; keep the top text above the cat's ears and the bottom text over the sofa below the cat's paws.
